<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Organograma ZAMine · Serviços Lundin Mining</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@700;800&family=Barlow:wght@500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Organograma ZAMine — arquivo independente: fotos embutidas, sem dependências além da fonte (opcional) */
.zm-org{--bg:#0d0c0b;--panel:#181614;--panel2:#211e1b;--line:#2e2a26;--fg:#f5f2ee;--muted:#9b948b;--accent:#ff6600;--link:#4a443d;
  font-family:"Barlow","Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);padding:32px 24px;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;overflow:hidden}
.zm-org.claro{--bg:#f6f4f1;--panel:#fff;--panel2:#ebe6e0;--line:#dcd4cb;--fg:#17130f;--muted:#6a625a;--accent:#f26100;--link:#c4b9ad}
.zm-org *{box-sizing:border-box}
.zm-org .hdr{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:24px}
.zm-org .hdr small{display:block;color:var(--accent);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:13px}
.zm-org .hdr h1{margin:4px 0 0;font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:40px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1}
.zm-org .vp{position:relative;width:100%}
.zm-org .tree{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(8,auto);grid-template-rows:1fr auto 1fr;width:max-content;transform-origin:0 0}
.zm-org .c{display:grid;grid-template-rows:subgrid;grid-row:1/4}
.zm-org .t{grid-row:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:center;padding:0 10px}
.zm-org .b{grid-row:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:center;padding:0 10px}
.zm-org .m{grid-row:2;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 10px;min-height:110px}
.zm-org .m.sp::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;border-top:3px solid var(--link);transform:translateY(-1.5px)}
.zm-org .c.first .m.sp::before{left:50%}
.zm-org .on{position:relative;z-index:1;width:236px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:16px 12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-align:center}
.zm-org .on.row{flex-direction:row;text-align:left;width:310px;padding:12px 16px 12px 12px;gap:14px}
.zm-org .on.vaga{border-style:dashed;background:transparent}
.zm-org .on.vaga b{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic}
.zm-org .ot{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0}
.zm-org .on b{font-size:24px;line-height:1.15}
.zm-org .on .ot span{font-size:18px;color:var(--accent);font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.zm-org .oa{width:96px;height:96px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--panel2);border:3px solid var(--accent)}
.zm-org .on.row .oa{width:76px;height:76px}
.zm-org .on.vaga .oa{border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--line)}
.zm-org .oa img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.zm-org .stem{display:block;width:3px;height:34px;background:var(--link);flex:none}
.zm-org .stem.dash{background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,var(--link) 0 9px,transparent 9px 15px)}
.zm-org .vh{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;transform:translateX(-1.5px)}
.zm-org .vh::before,.zm-org .vh::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;width:3px;height:50%}
.zm-org .vh.up::before{top:0;background:var(--link)}
.zm-org .vh.dn::after{bottom:0;background:var(--link)}
.zm-org .vh.dt::before,.zm-org .vh.db::after{background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,var(--link) 0 9px,transparent 9px 15px)}
.zm-org .base{grid-row:1/4;display:flex;align-items:center;position:relative}
.zm-org .base::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;width:36px;top:50%;border-top:3px solid var(--link);transform:translateY(-1.5px)}
.zm-org .bl{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;margin-left:36px}
.zm-org .bl::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:50px;bottom:50px;border-left:3px solid var(--link)}
.zm-org .bi{display:flex;align-items:center}
.zm-org .hst{display:block;width:30px;height:3px;background:var(--link);flex:none}
</style>
</head>
<body style="margin:0">
<!-- Para deixar com fundo branco, troque class="zm-org" por class="zm-org claro" -->
<section class="zm-org" id="zmOrg">
  <div class="hdr"><div><small>Services — Lundin Mining</small><h1>Nossa equipe</h1></div></div>
  <div class="vp"><div class="tree">
<div class="c first"><div class="t"></div><div class="m sp"><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Julio Sanches</b><span>Service Manager</span></div></div></div><div class="b"></div></div>
<div class="c"><div class="t"></div><div class="m sp"><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Wallysson Santos</b><span>Service Coordinator</span></div></div></div><div class="b"></div></div>
<div class="c"><div class="t"></div><div class="m sp"><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Fabricio Cesar</b><span>Service Supervisor</span></div></div></div><div class="b"></div></div>
<div class="c"><div class="t"></div><div class="m sp"><i class="vh dn"></i></div><div class="b"><i class="stem"></i><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Emerson Alexandre</b><span>Field Technical Specialist</span></div></div></div></div>
<div class="c"><div class="t"><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Ranielly Souza</b><span>Administrative Assistant</span></div></div><i class="stem"></i></div><div class="m sp"><i class="vh up dn"></i></div><div class="b"><i class="stem"></i><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Girlene Nogueira</b><span>Safety Technician</span></div></div></div></div>
<div class="c"><div class="t"><div class="on vaga"><div class="oa"></div><div class="ot"><b>Vaga em aberto</b><span>Specialist Technician</span></div></div><i class="stem"></i></div><div class="m sp"><i class="vh up dn db"></i></div><div class="b"><i class="stem dash"></i><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Marlon Mendes</b><span>Sales Department</span></div></div></div></div>
<div class="c"><div class="t"><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Max Rufino</b><span>Service Assistant</span></div></div><i class="stem"></i></div><div class="m sp"><i class="vh up dn"></i></div><div class="b"><i class="stem"></i><div class="on"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Marcos Rosa</b><span>Warehouse Assistant</span></div></div></div></div>
<div class="base"><div class="bl"><div class="bi"><i class="hst"></i><div class="on row"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Weslley Ferreira</b><span>Mechanical Technician</span></div></div></div><div class="bi"><i class="hst"></i><div class="on row"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Marcos Paulo</b><span>Mechanical Technician</span></div></div></div><div class="bi"><i class="hst"></i><div class="on row"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Marcelo Gonçalves</b><span>Mechanical Technician</span></div></div></div><div class="bi"><i class="hst"></i><div class="on row"><div class="oa"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div><div class="ot"><b>Higor Ataides</b><span>Mechanical Technician</span></div></div></div></div></div>
  </div></div>
</section>
<script>
/* ajusta o desenho à largura de onde ele for colocado */
(function(){
  var root=document.getElementById("zmOrg"), vp=root.querySelector(".vp"), t=root.querySelector(".tree");
  function fit(){ t.style.transform="none"; var s=Math.min(1, vp.clientWidth/t.scrollWidth); t.style.transform="scale("+s+")"; vp.style.height=(t.scrollHeight*s)+"px"; }
  window.addEventListener("resize",fit); if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready) document.fonts.ready.then(fit); fit();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
